text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock acceptance criteria + rollout plan for the eval-triggered Advisor feature. Customer asks are piling up, and solutions wants a clear handoff by EOW.
Devon: Do we have a concise list of what counts as an "eval trigger"? (thresholds, regression types)
Rory (applied-ml): Good q. Proposal: two trigger classes — 1) quality regression (delta in eval score > X) and 2) distribution shift (KL > Y or embedding drift).
Sam K: +1. For customers, they mainly care about precision drops and hallucination spikes. Can we make X configurable per-customer?
Elena: We should also include a latency/regression guard so Advisor doesn't recommend heavy quantization for low-latency apps without an approval flow.
Maya: Draft acceptance criteria suggestion: 
```
- Trigger types: quality_regression, embed_drift, hallucination_rate
- Configurable thresholds per-customer (default X=5%, KL=0.15, hallucination_rate delta=3%)
- Recommendation types: batching change, prefix/KV caching, quantization profile (Q4_INT8/Q4A), model variant fallback
- Safety gates: any quantization recommendation must pass regression eval (no >2% accuracy loss on golden prompts)
- Performance SLO: recommended config must not increase 95p latency by >15%
- Econ goal: candidate recommendation should estimate >=10% token-cost reduction or a measurable throughput gain
```
Rory (applied-ml): That looks reasonable. For quant thresholds we should provide expected uncertainty ranges and a simulation step (run on a small holdout set).
Devon: From infra side: we need a rollout flow — start with internal canary (alpha accounts), then partner customers, then GA. Ops needs a flag to disable automatic application of recommendations.
Elena: UX question: how will we surface the recommendation? inline in Console + email/SSE? Solutions wants a small explainer and a one-click apply button with preview.
Maya: Agreed — UI: preview diff + estimated econ impact + regression score. One-click apply should create a change request to Dedicated/Private clusters (flagged).
Sam K: Who owns the customer communication for initial pilots? I can coordinate with CS if we have a single doc and set of canned messages.
Maya: Sam, please own pilot comms. Devon + Rory + Elena to own technical gating and UI. I'll own prioritization + product acceptance.
Devon: Dependencies: (1) eval pipeline hook to emit standardized trigger events (PR by next Tue), (2) cost estimator endpoint (infra), (3) Console preview panel (frontend).
Rory (applied-ml): I'll push a prototype script that simulates recommendations and produces regression checks (by Fri).
sre-bot: deploy-bot: Eval event hook branch merged to staging at 3581240200 :white_check_mark:
Elena: Timeline check — if engineering delivers prototypes by next week, we can start a 2-week internal pilot the week after and target a partner pilot in 3 weeks.
Maya: Launch gating checklist (proposal):
- Internal pilot run with 3+ services and no critical regressions
- Partner pilot (2 customers) with documented econ wins and >80% acceptance of recommendations when offered as preview
- Monitoring dashboards for false positives, applied-config rollbacks, and customer opt-outs
- Runbook for engineers + support + legal signoff for Private deployments
Devon: Also add rollback automation: every applied recommendation must have an automated rollback plan if errors > threshold.
Sam K: I'll draft the pilot comms and pilot intake form. Want the one-pager to include: what triggers, what Advisor recommends, expected benefits, and opt-out instructions.
Maya: OK assigning tasks: Sam — pilot comms + intake doc, due Wed. Rory — regression sim prototype, due Fri. Devon — eval hook PR + rollout flag, due Tue. Elena — Console preview wireframes, due Thu. I'll circulate final acceptance criteria doc after Wed.
Elena: small note — make sure we include dedicated-tenant constraints for recommendations (some customers disallow quantization).
Maya: Good catch. Add to acceptance criteria: tenant-level policy overrides.
Rory (applied-ml): One more thought: surface confidence for each recommendation (low/med/high) and attach the holdout eval snapshot used. Helps SRE + CS trust.
Devon: Agreed. Also include a cost estimate delta per 1000 requests.
Maya: Great. If no objections, I'll slot this into the Optimize toolkit board and schedule the handoff meeting Friday 10am.
Sam K: fine with me :thumbsup:
Elena: good to go
Rory (applied-ml): sounds good
Maya: Thanks team — will send the doc + meeting invite.
